root_idea.summary: The root centers on thirst and on the interval of abstention between drinkings.
root_idea.development: The lexical development links the interval between two drinkings, ظِمْءٌ, with the thirst that arises during it, ظَمَأٌ, and extends to descriptions of the thirsty state, its causation, and endurance.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct attested Form I verb, normalized to its classical citation form.
Distinct Quran-attested adjectival form, normalized to the singular citation form.

senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb. In the Quranic occurrence, the imperfect is negated to express the absence of thirst.

senses.definition: Thirst; the condition of being thirsty.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun names the experience or condition of thirst.
An adjective describing one who is thirsty; the Quranic occurrence is substantivized and definite.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire or long to meet someone.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form IV; the lexical evidence allows variation in the degree of thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a horse lean or lank by sweating it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized use applied to a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To constrain oneself to endure a state of thirst.
Thirst; the condition of being thirsty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal form distinct from ظَمَأٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figurative desire or longing to meet someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical extension from the sense of thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interval between two drinkings or waterings, especially the period between a camel’s visits to water; also the period for which camels are kept from water during it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional term in the management of camels and other livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The period from birth to death; a lifetime.
Desirous or longing to meet someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival extension of thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Spare or lean, with little flesh; of joints, firm and well-braced rather than flabby.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to bodily features, a horse’s legs, and firm joints.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hot and dry, lacking moisture; said of a non-gentle wind.
Evilness of character: meanness of disposition and failure to deal equitably with associates.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an antelope or camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thirsty or arid place of the earth or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun describing land or ground.
A term for a person in extreme thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain-fed, receiving water only from rain rather than irrigation.
